notes: Inbound via HubSpot form from CTO. Currently using rule-based pipeline to summarize tickets; goal: reduce TTR and manual tagging. Wants: compact structured JSON (customer_id, issue_type, urgency, TL;DR), ability to call internal ticketing API (create/update) via tool-calls, and high precision on entity extraction (dates, order numbers). Prefers to prototype on hosted API (self-serve) — "fastest path to test". Cost sensitivity: wants to keep per-ticket cost < $0.01 if batchable; expects ~8-12k tickets/day at peak, mostly short messages. Latency target: median < 300ms for single-ticket summarize endpoint; can tolerate higher for batch jobs. Security: SOC2 required for vendor, SSO/SAML integration mandatory later, audit logs retained for 90 days. Sample POC plan: 2-week sandbox, ingest 10k sanitized tickets, compare F1 vs rules, run A/B on production traffic. Quotes from call: "Need high accuracy on dates and customer IDs — false positives cost support time." "We want to see how tool-calls could eliminate 30% of manual updates." Next steps: share ingestion spec, sanitized sample export, short checklist for SOC2 artifacts. Linked artifacts: drive deck + call transcript.
